gloss: to run down; to dash down

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {駆|か}け{下|お}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {駆|か}け{下|お}りていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {駆|か}け{下|お}りていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to run down; to dash down
definitions.explanation: To run quickly downward, such as descending stairs, a hill, or a slope at speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{下|お}りる。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{下|お}りて⟦きた→くる：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: He came running down the mountain path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{駆|か}け{下|お}りないで。
examples.english: It's dangerous, so don't run down.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run, to gallop) + ⟦{下|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to go down, to descend)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the path being traversed

ALTERNATE FORMS:
Also written as {駆|か}け{降|お}りる using a different kanji for おりる.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧: to run up
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧: to rush in
- ⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧: to run around

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{下|お}りる: to run down the stairs
- ⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{下|お}りる: to run down a slope
